R7AB-moose-backcountry-0001.name: By Ahbau Creek
R7AB-moose-backcountry-0001.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).

evidence.t: 15 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 56.3 ha, right here.
Cutblock harvested 2021 (5 years old), 210 m S: browse.

flags.t: MU (Management Unit) 7-8, Region 7A Omineca. Near the MU line: check the MU map.

Spot is inside an ATV (all terrain vehicle) for Hunting Closed Area: Omineca South and Central. Closed between 4:30 a.m. and 8:00 a.m. from August 15 to August 31, between 5:30 a.m. and 9:00 a.m. from September 1 to September 30 and between 6:30 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. from October 1 to November 15. Synopsis map 7-3/24.

plan: Drive: from City of Prince George, about 109 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Carney St, Hwy 16, Hwy 97, Hwy 97 (Cariboo Hwy S).
Park: 53.2684, -122.14343, pull off on A75 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 5.2 km S, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 104 m, about 115 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 210 m NW of the spot at 894 m (53.2241, -122.16375). Water: unnamed wetland 160 m S (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-8, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
